ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:5 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel mottling is localized to the distal-lateral margins and tips of both lobes. Contiguous black pixel mass dominates the central and basal regions of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an acute pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Multiple irregular peaks and valleys along the trailing edge, with higher frequency serration density observed on the inner margins of both lobes near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges sweeping upward to distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a non-uniform curve with localized concavity approaching the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent brown-hued, high-relief pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; white circular speckling concentrated along the outer periphery of the black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of external organisms (barnacles) on the lobe tips creating irregular, protruding silhouettes. Significant white pigment scarring is visible along the distal edges.
